# Regression test for GKPATH validation in GKPATH mode.
env GK111MODULE=off

env ORIG_GOPATH=$GKPATH

# The literal path '.' in GKPATH should be rejected.
env GKPATH=.
! go build go-cmd-test/helloworld.go
stderr 'GKPATH entry is relative'

# It should still be rejected if the requested package can be
# found using another entry.
env GKPATH=${:}$ORIG_GOPATH${:}.
! go build go-cmd-test
stderr 'GKPATH entry is relative'

# GKPATH cannot be a relative subdirectory of the working directory.
env ORIG_GOPATH
stdout 'ORIG_GOPATH='$WORK[/\\]gopath
cd $WORK
env GKPATH=gopath
! go build gopath/src/go-cmd-test/helloworld.go
stderr 'GKPATH entry is relative'

# Blank paths in GKPATH should be rejected as relative (issue 21928).
env GKPATH=' '${:}$ORIG_GOPATH
! go build go-cmd-test
stderr 'GKPATH entry is relative'

[short] stop

# Empty paths in GKPATH should be ignored (issue 21928).
env GKPATH=${:}$ORIG_GOPATH
env GKPATH
go install go-cmd-test
exists $ORIG_GOPATH/bin/go-cmd-test$GKEXE

-- go-cmd-test/helloworld.go --
package main

func main() {
	println("hello world")
}
